description: This file defines an internal interface 'IRemoteGrainDirectory' in the Orleans.Runtime namespace for managing distributed grain directories in a silo. It declares methods for registering multiple grains, looking up grains by address, and accepting split partition activations.

classes.name: IRemoteGrainDirectory
classes.description: An internal interface for managing distributed, partitioned grain-silo-activation directory in Orleans.

methods.name: RegisterMany
methods.description: Registers multiple grain addresses, intended for remote handoff scenarios.

methods.name: LookUpMany
methods.description: Fetches updated information on a list of grains, used for cache refresh.

methods.name: AcceptSplitPartition
methods.description: Registers activations resulting from a split partition.
